Farewell To Pikachu?! (Japanese: ピカチュウとの別れ!? Farewell To Pikachu!?) is the twenty second chapter of the Pokémon Gold & Silver: The Golden Boys manga.

==Plot==
 

==Major events==
Eusine explains how and why he sent back in time.
refuses to hand Pikachu to Eusine.
Chuck declares a battle to decide who gets to keep Pikachu.
Gold and send the SecretPotion to Olivine City.
Gold battles Eusine and wins, getting to keep Pikachu.
unseals the Black Tyranitar, which goes on a rampage.
